scope: High-risk Scene09 frames identified by local visual review.

shots.titleZh: 规则与目标确立 - 三位级长近景修复
shots.problem: Current frame is a wide battlefield geography view; Dimitri, Edelgard, and Claude are not readable enough for a leader/rules beat.

frame_intent.start: Three house leaders stand in a triangular rules briefing around the mock battle objective markers; all faces readable.
frame_intent.key: Dimitri, Edelgard, and Claude exchange tactical looks over the marked training field; the three-house balance is clear.
frame_intent.end: The leaders turn their attention toward separate lanes, preparing for a fair three-way contest.

hard_locks: house colors and academy uniforms preserved
no unnamed students, spectators, soldiers, crowds, or readable silhouettes
no subtitles, no visible text, no UI

shots.titleZh: 库罗德读出两个缺口 - 三人关系修复
shots.problem: Current frame works as Claude solo high point, but Ashe and Edelgard are too distant/weak to prove the intended three-character tactical relationship.

frame_intent.start: Claude watches from cover with bow lowered; Ashe and Edelgard are visible across two lanes, not tiny background figures.
frame_intent.key: Claude raises his training bow and reads two openings while Ashe reacts on one lane and Edelgard redirects on the other.
frame_intent.end: Claude holds the angle without firing lethally; Ashe and Edelgard remain readable as separate tactical targets.

hard_locks: Claude remains the strongest foreground read
Ashe and Edelgard must be readable named characters, not distant specks
no lethal arrow impact, blood, or humiliation
no subtitles, no visible text, no UI

shots.titleZh: 路线触发特写 - 菲力克斯直木剑修复
shots.problem: Current Felix weapon can read as chain/segmented blade rather than a blunt straight academy training sword.

frame_intent.start: Felix leans into the tempting route with a single straight blunt wooden training sword; Byleth watches the line.
frame_intent.key: Byleth stops Felix with a precise hand gesture; Felix's straight wooden sword is visible and nonlethal.
frame_intent.end: Felix checks his step and lowers the straight wooden sword, accepting the tactical call.

hard_locks: Felix weapon is one straight blunt wooden training sword
no chain blade, segmented blade, whip sword, metal edge, glowing relic, or sharp point
no subtitles, no visible text, no UI
